meaning.en: Om, I will set out the diamond-needle teaching
meaning.hi: ॐ, मैं वज्रसूचिका प्रस्तुत करूँगा

meaning.en: a teaching that pierces through ignorance
meaning.hi: अज्ञान को भेदने वाला शास्त्र

meaning.en: a flaw for those lacking knowledge
meaning.hi: ज्ञानहीनों के लिए दूषण

meaning.en: an ornament for those with the eye of knowledge
meaning.hi: ज्ञान-चक्षुओं के लिए भूषण

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: so then, what does the word Brahmin actually mean
meaning.hi: तो फिर ब्राह्मण का नाम क्या है

meaning.en: whoever has recognized the self as one without a second, free of caste, quality, and action
meaning.hi: जो आत्मा को अद्वितीय, जाति-गुण-क्रिया रहित जानता है

meaning.en: free of the six waves, the six states, and every related flaw
meaning.hi: षडूर्मि-षड्भाव आदि सर्वदोष रहित

meaning.en: whose nature is truth, knowledge, bliss, and infinity
meaning.hi: सत्य-ज्ञान-आनंद-अनंत स्वरूप

meaning.en: made as directly evident as a fruit placed in one's own palm
meaning.hi: हथेली में रखे फल की तरह प्रत्यक्ष जानकर

words.sanskrit: sa eva brahmana iti shruti-smriti-itihasa-puranabhyam abhiprayah

meaning.en: this alone, according to scripture, tradition, history and legend, is what Brahmin means
meaning.hi: यही श्रुति-स्मृति-इतिहास-पुराणों का अभिप्राय है कि यही ब्राह्मण है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Shudra are the four classes
meaning.hi: ब्राह्मण-क्षत्रिय-वैश्य-शूद्र चार वर्ण हैं

meaning.en: among these classes, the Brahmin is declared foremost
meaning.hi: इन वर्णों में ब्राह्मण ही प्रधान है

words.sanskrit: ko va brahmano nama kim jivah kim dehah kim jatih

meaning.en: what indeed is a Brahmin — the soul, the body, the caste
meaning.hi: ब्राह्मण क्या है — जीव, देह, जाति

words.sanskrit: kim jnanam kim karma kim dharmikah iti

meaning.en: is it knowledge, is it action, or is it being righteous
meaning.hi: ज्ञान, कर्म, या धार्मिक होना

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tatra prathamo jivo brahmana iti chet tanna

meaning.en: if it be said the soul is the Brahmin, that is not so
meaning.hi: यदि कहें जीव ब्राह्मण है, तो यह सही नहीं

meaning.en: because the soul remains one in form across past and future bodies
meaning.hi: अतीत-अनागत अनेक देहों में जीव के एकरूप होने से

meaning.en: and due to karma, it comes to occupy many bodies
meaning.hi: कर्मवश अनेक देहों की संभावना से

meaning.en: therefore the soul is not the Brahmin
meaning.hi: अतः जीव ब्राह्मण नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tarhi deho brahmana iti chet tanna

meaning.en: if it be said the body is the Brahmin, that is not so
meaning.hi: यदि कहें देह ब्राह्मण है, तो यह सही नहीं

meaning.en: since all bodies are equally made of the five elements
meaning.hi: पंचभौतिक होने से देह के एकरूप होने के कारण

words.sanskrit: brahmanah shveta-varnah kshatriyo rakta-varnah iti niyama-abhavat

meaning.en: there is no fixed rule that Brahmins are pale and Kshatriyas red, and so on
meaning.hi: ब्राह्मण श्वेतवर्ण, क्षत्रिय रक्तवर्ण आदि का कोई नियम नहीं

meaning.en: since cremating a father's body brings no charge of killing a Brahmin
meaning.hi: पिता आदि के शरीर के दहन में ब्रह्महत्या आदि दोष न होने से

meaning.en: therefore the body is not the Brahmin
meaning.hi: अतः देह ब्राह्मण नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tarhi jatir brahmana iti chet tanna

meaning.en: if it be said caste is the Brahmin, that is not so
meaning.hi: यदि कहें जाति ब्राह्मण है, तो यह सही नहीं

meaning.en: Rishyashringa born of a deer, Kaushika from kusha grass
meaning.hi: ऋष्यशृंग मृगी से, कौशिक कुश से

meaning.en: Valmiki from an anthill, Vyasa from a fisherwoman
meaning.hi: वाल्मीकि वल्मीक से, व्यास मछुआरिन से

meaning.en: Vasishtha born of Urvashi, Agastya born of a water-pot
meaning.hi: वसिष्ठ उर्वशी से, अगस्त्य कलश से जन्मे

meaning.en: therefore birth-caste is not the Brahmin
meaning.hi: अतः जाति ब्राह्मण नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tarhi jnanam brahmana iti chet tanna

meaning.en: if it be said knowledge is the Brahmin, that is not so
meaning.hi: यदि कहें ज्ञान ब्राह्मण है, तो यह सही नहीं

meaning.en: since Kshatriyas and others too have had deep insight into ultimate truth
meaning.hi: क्षत्रिय आदि भी परमार्थदर्शी अभिज्ञ बहुत हैं

meaning.en: therefore knowledge is not the Brahmin
meaning.hi: अतः ज्ञान ब्राह्मण नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tarhi karma brahmana iti chet tanna

meaning.en: if it be said action is the Brahmin, that is not so
meaning.hi: यदि कहें कर्म ब्राह्मण है, तो यह सही नहीं

meaning.en: since all beings alike act driven by past, accumulated, and future karma
meaning.hi: सभी प्राणियों में प्रारब्ध-संचित-आगामी कर्म की समानता देखने से

meaning.en: therefore action is not the Brahmin
meaning.hi: अतः कर्म ब्राह्मण नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tarhi dharmiko brahmana iti chet tanna

meaning.en: if it be said the righteous person is the Brahmin, that is not so
meaning.hi: यदि कहें धार्मिक ब्राह्मण है, तो यह सही नहीं

meaning.en: since Kshatriyas and others too are generous givers of gold
meaning.hi: क्षत्रिय आदि भी हिरण्यदाता बहुत हैं

meaning.en: therefore the righteous person is not the Brahmin
meaning.hi: अतः धार्मिक ब्राह्मण नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
